name: 7394-concurrentstream-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. An 8B bf16 checkpoint fits one card.
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), rate=10 req/s -- the declared operating point, scored -- with a second sweep point at rate=25 req/s reported beside it. Bounded at 5120 requests / 1800 s safety per point, warmup the first 30% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, streaming. 550 prompt tokens (a 200-token shared prefix, `prefix_count: 1`, plus 350 request-specific) and EXACTLY 150 output tokens, min = max on each. `ignore_eos` is forced whenever max_tokens is set, so no request stops early.
purpose: A shared-preamble 8B chat assistant streaming single-turn replies at 10 to 25 requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
enable-chunked-prefill: true
disable-log-requests: true

# With no --max-num-batched-tokens passed, this engine resolves the budget to 512 WHEN CHUNKED
# PREFILL IS ON, against max(max_model_len, 2048) when it is off. The resolved value is written
# down here because it depends on another flag.
max-num-batched-tokens: 512
max-num-seqs: 256

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096

# enable-prefix-caching is absent, and off is this engine's default. The prompts share a 200-token
# prefix by construction, so turning it on would change the request shape.
